title: Etale cohomology of a limit of schemes
statement:
Let $(X_i,f_{i'i})_{i\in I}$ be a directed inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine transition morphisms $f_{i'i}:X_{i'}\to X_i$ ($i'\ge i$), each $X_i$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $X=\varprojlim_iX_i$ with projections $f_i:X\to X_i$, let $(\mathcal F_i,\varphi_{i'i})$ be a system of abelian sheaves on $(X_i)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with $\varphi_{i'i}:f_{i'i}^{-1}\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F_{i'}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and set $\mathcal F=\varinjlim_if_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i$. Then the pullback maps induce an isomorphism
$$
\varinjlim_iH^p((X_i)_{\Et},\mathcal F_i)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }H^p(X_{\Et},\mathcal F)\qquad(p\ge0)
$$
($H^p$ etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], the maps those of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] followed by $\varphi$ and the coprojections). In particular, for a directed system of rings $(C_i)$ with colimit $C$, $\operatorname{Spec}C=\varprojlim\operatorname{Spec}C_i$ with affine transition maps (Stacks Limits, Lemma 01YW), and for an abelian sheaf $G$ on $T_{\Et}$ and compatible maps $v_i:\operatorname{Spec}C_i\to T$ with limit $v:\operatorname{Spec}C\to T$ one gets $\varinjlim_iH^p(\operatorname{Spec}C_i,v_i^{-1}G)\cong H^p(\operatorname{Spec}C,v^{-1}G)$.

proof.text: Apply the finite-stage class-existence and finite-stage zero-detection statements to the supplied canonical system, diagram H and cocone B. These are independent halves of the original steps 1-8, neither asserting the full colimit property.

Let q=colimit.desc H B. A colimit element z killed by q has a stage representative x. The canonical-leg equation identifies q(x) with b_i(x). Zero detection gives a transition H(f) killing x. The colimit relation colimit.w_apply identifies z with the coprojection of H(f)(x)=0, so z=0. Thus q is injective. For y in B.pt, class existence gives i,x with b_i(x)=y; the coprojection of x maps to y by colimit.ι_desc, proving surjectivity. Shrink the forgetful functor filtered-colimit preservation from coefficient universe u+1 to index universe u. The forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, so q is an isomorphism. IsColimit.ofPointIso transfers the group-colimit universal property to B. This assembly is fully proved in Lean.

*The case of rings.* Let $(C_i)$ be a directed system of rings with colimit $C$. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit], $\operatorname{Spec}C=\varprojlim\operatorname{Spec}C_i$ with affine transition maps, and the affine schemes $\operatorname{Spec}C_i$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Given $G$ on $T_{\Et}$ and $v_i:\operatorname{Spec}C_i\to T$ with $v_i=v_{i'}$-compatible ($v_{i'}=v_i\circ f_{i'i}$) and limit $v=v_i\circ f_i$, put $\mathcal F_i=v_i^{-1}G$ and $\varphi_{i'i}=c:f_{i'i}^{-1}v_i^{-1}G\xrightarrow{\sim}v_{i'}^{-1}G$ of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]; its compatibility with triple composites gives the cocycle condition. Then each $f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i\cong v^{-1}G$ via $c$, and the transition maps $\psi_{i'i}$ of step 1 become the identity of $v^{-1}G$ under these isomorphisms, so $\mathcal F=\varinjlim f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i\cong v^{-1}G$ by [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-constant-connected-diagram] ($I$ is directed, hence connected). The theorem gives $\varinjlim_iH^p(\operatorname{Spec}C_i,v_i^{-1}G)\cong H^p(\operatorname{Spec}C,v^{-1}G)$, the maps being the pullbacks $f_i^*$ followed by $H^p(c)$. In Lean the identity, cocycle and constant-diagram comparison equations are supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-compatible-pullback-sheaf-system]; the remaining proof constructs the constant cocone, invokes steps 1-8, and checks that its cohomology legs are the prescribed comparisons.

Stacks' proof only works literally when the X_i are affine (09YP computes cohomology over an object of the site; a non-affine X_i is not an object of (X_i)_{affine,etale}, which then has no final object); the qcqs case is reduced to it by an agent-written Mayer-Vietoris induction (separated case, then general), which needs the new lem-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-pullback (naturality of Mayer-Vietoris in pullbacks), lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition (Limits 01YX: existence of the limit and open preimages) and the Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-abelian-groups-exact. The ring case uses the Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit (01YW). Statement unchanged; stmt_deps unchanged.
